posts.title: A Future Direction for Stellagama Publishing

posts.title: Simpler Living
posts.description: Faced with a cluttered home, overwork, and financial insecurity, I have decide to simplify my life and drastically cut my expenses. This has a simple monetary component, namely cutting back on my cost of living to get out of debt and eventually reduce work.
